children: Apple (AAPL) beat fiscal Q4 estimates with revenue up 12% to $114.48 billion and EPS up 14% to $2.10. Shares fell about 3% after it forecast 7%–10% December-quarter revenue growth.
Apple Inc. (AAPL) announced a deal to use Google’s Gemini AI technology to help power Siri and Apple Intelligence. The agreement is worth about $1 billion annually.
Apple (AAPL) posted record China sales in the September quarter, helping offset rising component costs, including memory. It also outperformed rivals amid weak consumer demand.
Apple (AAPL) was set to report earnings after Monday’s close. Investors awaited updates on iPhone 18 Pro and Duo demand, rising memory costs, and CEO John Ternus’ first earnings report.
Apple trades at 36 times forward earnings, its highest valuation since 2008. Since late July, at least six analysts downgraded the stock, while Buy or Overweight ratings fell to 27 from 33.
Apple (AAPL) unveiled the iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, new home devices, and brought Touch to Mac for the first time.
JPMorgan says Apple’s Duo delivery times were unchanged in week eight, while Pro lead times continued to normalize. The sales outlook is weaker year over year and relies on premium Duo demand.
Apple’s iPhone shipments fell 4% in Q3, while the overall smartphone market dropped 21%, according to preliminary IDC data. The results exceeded analyst expectations.
Court documents show Google paid Apple (AAPL) $20 billion in 2022 to remain the default search engine on Apple devices. No newer payment figure has been disclosed.
Apple (AAPL) trades at about 36 times forward earnings, MoffettNathanson’s Craig Moffett said. Higher memory costs and device prices may lead customers to keep iPhones longer and delay upgrades.
